---
title: "A title bar kept with its code across a page break"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

Each window below starts 3em above the bottom of a page.
That leaves room for the title bar but not for the first line of code.

```{=typst}
#set page(height: 10cm, margin: 1cm)
#v(8cm - 3em)
```

```{.python filename="plain.py"}
plain_first = 1
plain_second = 2
```

```{=typst}
#pagebreak()
#v(8cm - 3em)
```

```{.python filename="annotated.py"}
annotated_first = 1 # <1>
annotated_second = 2
```

1. The first line.
